consensus: All models separate bounded working memory from episodic, semantic, and procedural memory, and all require provenance.
notable_disagreements_or_outliers: Gemini emphasizes cold-storage tiering; Qwen frames context as an L1 cache; Perplexity emphasizes freshness and source quality as typed fields.
implementation_decision_for_cognitive_os: Use `modules/memory/` for typed stores, keep event provenance first, and promote semantic/procedural records only through evidence-linked consolidation.

consensus: Models converge on observe-plan-verify-act-reflect loops where LLMs propose plans but do not execute them directly.
notable_disagreements_or_outliers: Qwen proposes constrained MCTS; Cohere proposes HTN/MCTS-style planning; DeepSeek stresses cheaper checks before expensive planning.
implementation_decision_for_cognitive_os: Start with deterministic typed plan objects and verifier feedback in `core/orchestration/planner_runtime.py`, then add optional search only where it improves measured outcomes.

consensus: No model recommends unconstrained online weight updates. Learning should modify procedures, prompts, route policy, memory, and verifier predicates through offline gates.
notable_disagreements_or_outliers: Qwen mentions optional offline LoRA adapters; Mistral emphasizes sovereign/local learning; DeepSeek emphasizes cost-aware updates.
implementation_decision_for_cognitive_os: Use `core/runtime/failure_learning.py`, `core/runtime/end_to_end_learning.py`, and `modules/memory/promotion_rules.py` for shadow-mode change packets with rollback.

consensus: Every model requires capability-scoped tools, sandboxing, preconditions, postconditions, and side-effect records.
notable_disagreements_or_outliers: Qwen suggests macaroon-like tokens; Grok suggests signed leases; Cohere compares side effects to financial transactions.
implementation_decision_for_cognitive_os: Route actions through `core/orchestration/verifier_runtime.py`, `core/orchestration/execution_control.py`, and `tools/managed_vm/` before external mutation.

consensus: All models want typed entity/world state separate from raw memory, with evidence links and forecast/outcome deltas.
notable_disagreements_or_outliers: Qwen and Cohere favor early causal/Bayesian models; Perplexity prioritizes source freshness; Gemini emphasizes temporal reconciliation.
implementation_decision_for_cognitive_os: Begin with `core/world_model/` and `modules/world_model/` typed entities plus observed deltas; introduce causal graphs only for domains with testable forecasts.

consensus: Governance is a runtime service with policies, refusals, escalations, human controls, and audit records.
notable_disagreements_or_outliers: Qwen names OPA/Rego; Grok proposes retrievable policy precedents; Mistral stresses local/private governance.
implementation_decision_for_cognitive_os: Use `modules/governance/gate.py`, `modules/governance/object_store.py`, and `core/orchestration/governance_runtime.py` as the first enforcement surfaces.

consensus: Models agree on unit tests, integration replay, red teams, soak tests, and regression gates before learning promotion.
notable_disagreements_or_outliers: Perplexity adds source freshness/retrieval-quality evals; DeepSeek adds cost/latency as safety metrics.
implementation_decision_for_cognitive_os: Extend existing `runtime/evals/` and soak runners with action replay, verifier bypass tests, and memory-promotion regression cases.

consensus: All models treat append-only events and materialized state as the safety backbone.
notable_disagreements_or_outliers: Qwen proposes distributed queues and RocksDB; Gemini proposes SQLite/pgvector; Grok wants signed logs.
implementation_decision_for_cognitive_os: Start local and inspectable with `core/runtime/event_journal.py`, `core/runtime/evidence_ledger.py`, and `core/runtime/state_store.py`; defer distributed infrastructure.

consensus: Models prefer specialist roles coordinated through shared state rather than hidden shared chat.
notable_disagreements_or_outliers: Some outputs recommend voting/consensus for high-impact decisions; others favor a single orchestrator with critics/verifiers.
implementation_decision_for_cognitive_os: Use planner, critic, verifier, executor, and curator roles, but reserve consensus for high-impact decisions to avoid latency inflation.

consensus: All models can map to a 90-day local-first prototype if dependencies stay modest and AGI claims are avoided.
notable_disagreements_or_outliers: Qwen/Cohere are most ambitious; DeepSeek/Mistral are most cost/privacy constrained.
implementation_decision_for_cognitive_os: Prototype ledger/state, governed action path, and memory promotion first; add causal/search machinery only after verifier and replay foundations are stable.

consensus: The strongest shared non-obvious idea is that the LLM context window is a cache over a governed cognitive transaction system.
notable_disagreements_or_outliers: Individual emphases differ: uncertainty as runtime object, governance precedent as evidence, efficiency as safety, and freshness as typed memory metadata.
implementation_decision_for_cognitive_os: Make beliefs, plans, permissions, actions, and learning updates lifecycle-managed objects with provenance and rollback.
